stem.flightsim.coaching_challenge_comple: Ivyabonetse vyerekanye ko intumbero z’igerageza zashitsweko. Ubu, mu mwimenyerezo wo gucunga inguvu, gereranya kumanuka moteri ikora ku muvuduko muto no kuduga ukoresheje inguvu za moteri.
stem.flightsim.coaching_energy_complete: Ivyabonetse vyerekanye ko intumbero zo gucunga inguvu zashitsweko. Ubu imenyereze kugenzura inguvu mu rugendo rugufi rwo kwegera ikibuga c’indege, hanyuma ugereranye umuvuduko wo kumanuka no gukora hasi.
stem.flightsim.drone_battery_low: Batiri iri hafi guhera: hasigaye {pct}%. Subira aho wahagurukiye maze wururuke vuba.
stem.flightsim.drone_battery_depleted_bo: Igihe umuriro wa batiri washika kuri 0%, ukuguruka kwahagaritswe vy’agateganyo. Sozera igikorwa kugira ngo usuzume iri gerageza, hanyuma utangure igikorwa gishasha ufise batiri yuzuye.
stem.flightsim.geoq_nearest_place: Ni hehe hegereye cane aho uri ubu?
stem.flightsim.geoq_paused: Ukuguruka kwahagaritswe vy’agateganyo kubera iki kibazo. Funga ibibazo, hanyuma uhitemwo Kubandanya igihe witeguriye kuguruka.
stem.flightsim.geoq_unavailable: Nta kibazo c’ubumenyi bw’isi kiriho ku hantu hafi yawe. Bandanya kurondera maze wongere ugerageze.
